shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan at the shelf-side window seat tells a story about a personal blunder, a man in a mustard hoodie is at the doorway-side window seat, and a woman in an emerald blouse is at the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in the mustard hoodie asks the woman in the navy cardigan about the consequence.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the navy cardigan replies to the man in the mustard hoodie.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the game table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
